description: One report on a business partner before invoicing or delivering: VAT ID (VIES or Swiss UID register), EORI customs number (the given one, or the VAT ID tried as EORI), Peppol e-invoicing (per identifier, whether the provider's SMP lists a recognised invoice type; this does not prove delivery), and LEI (with the parent company when an LEI is given, otherwise up to 3 possible matches by name). Each part has its own status, and names its source and time where a source was asked. A part that does not apply is left out: EORI for a Swiss UID, a GB VAT number or after a format error of the VAT ID, unless an EORI is given; Peppol for a GB VAT number and after a format error of the VAT ID; LEI when no LEI is given and no name is known (from the VAT register, the EORI service or the input). A part whose source is down says so without affecting the others, except LEI, which is left out when that leaves no name. No sanctions screening.

eori.description: Optional: the partner's EORI number, if different from the VAT ID.

name.description: Optional: the partner's name, used for the LEI search when neither the VAT register (VIES or the Swiss UID register) nor the EORI service gives a name; ignored when lei is given.

requester_vat_id.description: Optional: the user's OWN EU VAT ID. If given and accepted by VIES, a valid EU VAT ID is answered with a consultation number as official proof of the check (not for Swiss UIDs). Only pass it when the user provided their own VAT ID for this purpose.

vat_id.description: The partner's VAT ID or Swiss UID.
